description: This PHP class 'AssignClaimController' is part of a Human Resource Management system, specifically handling the assignment of claims in the Claim module. It extends an abstract Vue.js controller and utilizes traits for authentication and service management. The class provides methods to access a pay grade service and prepares data for rendering a Vue component related to claim assignments.

classes.name: AssignClaimController
classes.description: Controller handling claim assignment UI component rendering, extending AbstractVueController, providing services and preparing Vue component for claim assignment related interface.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance used to fetch currency data for the claim assignment component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue component for rendering the claim assignment UI, setting currencies and employee number properties.
